name: Server-Side Request Forgery
steps: Identify every input that becomes a server-issued request (URL/host/path params, webhooks, importers, renderers, preview/screenshot features).
Point it at loopback and link-local / cloud-metadata ranges; compare the response to a benign external control you can observe.
Try alternate URI schemes and encodings to defeat allow-list filters and string normalisation.
Use an out-of-band listener to confirm blind cases where no response body comes back.
On confirmation, pivot to internal services, cloud metadata, or local resource retrieval per the engagement objective.
